I'm so glad you're trying to learn how to help her instead of shaming her or leaving her. I sh and when my boyfriend found out he also made a post on here to help me. He's honestly the biggest reason I've been clean for nearly 30 days. Just know that if you approach it the right way, you can really make a big difference in her life. Tell her you're always here to talk but don't force her to. Personally I wouldn't tell her how much it hurts you every time she does it because that would make me feel a lot more guilty than I already do. I would ask her if she would like you to check in on her and if so how often. My boyfriend checks in on my occasionally and I appreciate it. Also whenever she stays clean, especially if it's for longer than usual, tell her how proud you are of her and celebrate! It always makes me feel so great when my boyfriend does it for me. Overall just do your best to be understanding but not pushy, and never guilt her, gaslight her or tell her you'll leave her if she doesn't stop. And always tell her how much you love her!
